query: Applicant goals for minority, women and service-disabled veteran utilization are expected to meet or exceed New York State's 30 percent MWBE contract utilization goal.

facts.text: The RFA expects applicants' MWBE contract-utilization goals to meet or exceed the state's 30% target.
RWNYC's license requires public community-benefits progress reports that include workforce diversity data.
Each licensee is required to post and update its community advisory committee commitments.
In October 2026 the Commission chair reported that monitors for all three casino licensees were in place.
The Board reported that RWNYC provided no specific MWBE contractor utilization goal.
RWNYC held a supplier outreach session for prospective MWBE contractors.
RWNYC broke ground on Phase II of its expansion in July 2026.

conditions.text: The applicable applicant adopted an MWBE contracting goal of at least 30%.
Actual eligible contracting at RWNYC reached the 30% MWBE utilization benchmark on a defined contract denominator.

reference_verdict.reasoning: §5 decision order: (1) a utilization rate can be evidenced, so not 'not applicable'; (2) construction has been under way since early 2026, so not 'not yet due'; (3) no sources disagree; (4) no independent source reports RWNYC MWBE utilization; (5) RWNYC has made no claim about it either; (6) the CMT's reports to the Commission are a known non-public source, but nothing shows they cover MWBE utilization; (7) → no public evidence located. Searched: web/news, Gale OneFile: News (64 RWNYC articles, Dec 2025–Nov 2026), Gaming Commission minutes/transcripts, GFLB report. Competing reading: source unavailable, if the CMT reports are confirmed to include MWBE data. Note the required public progress report (License Condition 3) has not been located, which is itself a finding.

sources.title: GFLB final report and findings
sources.specific_evidence: RWNYC gave no specific MWBE contractor goals; its construction workforce goals are 5% women, 40% minorities, ~5% service-disabled veterans (below the State's 6% minimum). Board doubts any applicant can meet MWBE goals alongside union and local-hire pledges.
sources.notes: Regulator commentary (guide §7: quote in notes). Shows no RWNYC-specific MWBE target exists.
